## What you are trying to do

## Have you tried `bb_request`?

`bb_list_endpoints` plus `bb_request` reach every Bitbucket Cloud endpoint, so
most gaps can already be worked around. Knowing whether that path worked — and
what was awkward about it — is the best argument for a typed tool.

## Why a typed tool would be better

A tool earns its place in the schema when the payload is easy to get wrong, the
raw response is far larger than needed, or the operation is visible to other
people and deserves explicit arguments. Which applies here?
